evals.prompt: Make an interactive HTML map of our billing services that I can click through to see each worker's retry rules and follow how an order event moves upstream and downstream.
Build an HTML explainer of our 35-node data pipeline where new engineers can pan and zoom around, click a job to read its inputs and outputs in a drawer, and highlight everything connected to it.
I want a single-file web page showing our checkout, fraud, and ledger subsystems as grouped boxes I can zoom into and explore hop by hop.
Create an explorable architecture page for the webhook router with stage lanes from intake to delivery, where clicking any service lights up its call path and shows its runbook notes.
Turn our dependency graph of 25 microservices and queues into an offline HTML artifact I can pan, zoom, and click to inspect each service's upstream callers and downstream dependencies.
Make an HTML runbook page with an interactive topology diagram of our regional caches, databases, and workers so on-call can click a failing node and trace every affected path.
Show our event-driven fulfillment flow on a companion screen as an interactive graph I can pan and click through to inspect each queue and worker before we pick a design.
Build an HTML page that maps how customer events flow across our analytics collectors, Kafka topics, and warehouse tables, with clickable nodes that open each table's schema notes.
Add a simple static flowchart of the 4-step login redirect check to this HTML report.
Include a sequence diagram showing the OAuth token exchange between the browser, the auth server, and the API gateway on the HTML explainer page.
Draw a state chart of an order's lifecycle (draft, pending, paid, refunded, voided) in the HTML page.
Put a small static diagram of the three-box retry loop in the report page; nobody needs to click or zoom it.
Write a diagram of the retry flow for this README in Markdown.
Add an entity-relationship diagram of the users, subscriptions, and charges tables to the HTML design write-up.
Show a quick static Mermaid diagram on the companion screen using the diagram field to illustrate the two-step approval sequence.
Include a class diagram of the parser interfaces in our HTML technical overview.
